PSG vs. Lyon — Last 5 Form Guide [...] Their latest performance was particularly eye-catching, as they defeated Barcelona 4-2 in the Champions League, showing their attacking quality against the Spanish side, with Desire Doue among those on the scoresheet, but the victory came at a considerable cost.

PSG to win

PSG have won seven consecutive competitive matches and have been particularly productive in attack, including their 4-2 Champions League victory over Barcelona. Their injury problems make this a more difficult assignment, but home advantage and their recent form give them the edge against a Lyon side coming off a 3-0 European defeat.
